originalTitle: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
summary: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.
content: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.
chineseTitle: 牛市往往会伴随着一阵呜咽而不是一声巨响而见顶——但标准普尔 500 指数接下来可能会出现 15% 的回调
chineseSummary: 与熊市底部不同的是，熊市底部通常会随着交易者认输而导致一阵绝望，而牛市顶部则要渐进得多，也不那么引人注目。
